memory_update.text: SENEA is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for private-label food processing and contract packing; verify private-label revenue mix, customer concentration, capacity, and crop-cost pass-through.

NAII is a pure but micro-cap speculative-shadow candidate for private-label supplement contract manufacturing; later layers must heavily penalize liquidity, customer concentration, and balance-sheet risk unless filings show improvement.

CENTA is a broader pet/garden private-label manufacturer/distributor candidate; exposure is plausible but not pure, so private-label revenue split and retailer concentration are critical next evidence.
SW is useful as a reference packaging leader for shelf-ready/FMCG packaging, but its large size and diversified exposure make it less likely to be the main underfollowed alpha candidate.

TreeHouse Foods would have been the cleanest public private-label food manufacturing comp, but it became private after the February 11, 2026 Investindustrial acquisition; public-market discovery should now search for smaller remaining processors, supplement manufacturers, pet/household private-label suppliers, and packaging firms.

node: Private-label co-manufacturing, specialty ingredients, labels, flexible packaging, and shelf-ready packaging
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the private-label manufacturing and packaging node. The cleanest historical public pure play, TreeHouse Foods, should be treated as a now-private reference comp rather than a candidate because Investindustrial completed its acquisition on February 11, 2026. Current US-listed exposure appears split between: packaged-food private-label processors, health/supplement contract manufacturers, pet/lawn private-label manufacturers, and large shelf-ready packaging suppliers. The underfollowed lane is stronger than the reference lane, but most candidates require customer, certification, and capacity verification before surviving later Serenity layers.
